quests.title: Qingce's Lanterns

dialogue.t: *sigh* The Lantern Rite is here once again...

dialogue.sit: Is there something on your mind, Granny Ruoxin?

dialogue.t: Things should be festive and lively during the Lantern Rite, you know?
But in Qingce Village, the elderly are too old and the young are too young.
All those young workers that have since flocked to the big city are either too busy and can't get time off work to celebrate the festival...
Or they're too far away to make it back home in time.
Lantern Rite is a lively festival, it's a time when everyone should gather together to celebrate...
Sure, I understand that it mustn't be easy for them either, but... *sigh* What about all the festivities?
Ugh, there's no use in complaining. That's no way to celebrate...
If you'd be so kind, I'm sure Ms. Bai could use a hand right about now.
The young lady said that she wanted to prepare a table full of food for everyone and is already hard at work on the preparations. I'm afraid that she won't be able to manage on her own...

dialogue.sit: Don't worry, I'll go lend her a hand.

dialogue.t: Oh, thank you. You're too kind!
Seems we still need quite a few more ingredients...
Let me lend you a hand.
Huh? Oh, are you willing to help? You've come right on time! I was just starting to worry that we wouldn't manage to get all the ingredients.
Let me see here... If you could, please help me get three chunks of Raw Meat and three pieces of Fowl.
In the meantime, I'll think of a way to procure the other ingredients.
*sigh* Who knows when the young folks will finally get some time to rest...
Great, that should be just enough. Ah yes, I'll also need you to help me go to Pops Kai and tell him to bring all the chairs and tables over.
I plan on making lots of dishes, so if we wait too long to set up the tables, I'm afraid that the food might start getting cold.
Were you able to get those three chunks of Raw Meat and Fowl?
Oh? Are you looking for me?

dialogue.sit: We'll be needing the tables and chairs soon.

dialogue.t: Ah yes, the tables and chairs... I remember now. I've already prepared everything.
Ah, but there should still be some more inside the shop. Alrighty, let's just bring them all out then.
That should be enough tables and chairs for everybody.
I never expected that you'd come all the way here to help me.

dialogue.sit: I'm happy that I could help.

dialogue.t: Heh! I must say that you're quite an extraordinary young man(lady)... But why haven't you gone home yet? Don't you plan on celebrating with your family?
No need to fret, I won't ask any further. I'm sure you have your reasons.
If you're willing to celebrate the festival here, you're more than welcome to join us. As they say, the more the merrier.
I think we've got just about everything we need...
Ah, you're back. Sorry for making you do so much work on a festive day like this.
Thank you, you're too kind. I've also been doing my part and managed to make quite a few Xiao Lanterns for the people of Qingce Village.
If you'd like, you can find me near the gate later this evening. We'll release the Xiao Lanterns and celebrate the festival together.
But who knows where the children have run off to... There's no way I could go and find them with these old legs...
Could I trouble you to round them up for me? They've always loved releasing the Xiao Lanterns.
And be sure to tell anyone else you find along the way to head back to the village... The more the merrier, you know.
This year's festival is turning out to be quite the big one...
Ugh, I still can't catch my shadow.

dialogue.sit: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogue.t: We get to release the Xiao Lanterns tonight? Awesome! Lemme go tell my big brother!
I heard grandpa say that we get to make a wish when we release the lanterns. Is that true?
I have a big wish that I've been thinking about for a long time now...
It's that I... Ah wait, I shouldn't tell you... Grandpa says that if we tell others our wishes, they'll never come true.
Just wait till I tell my big brother, I'm sure he'll have a wish too!
Oh wait, it seems we have to write our wish on a lantern... So I guess just thinking about it won't be enough.
I wonder if Mr. Adeptus will come to Lantern Rite...

dialogue.sit: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogue.t: Oh, we'll be releasing the lanterns back at the village? Thanks for letting me know.
If we release enough Xiao Lanterns, maybe Mr. Adeptus will come...
Ah, hello. Do you need anything?

dialogue.sit: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogue.t: Granny Ruoxin will be releasing the lanterns? *sigh* She'll probably start to worry if I don't show up...
Alright, thanks for letting me know. I'll make my way over there shortly. At a festival like this one... the more, the merrier.
Wife... Wife?

dialogue.sit: We'll be releasing Xiao Lanterns in the village soon...

dialogue.t: Xiao Lanterns? Ah yes, I remember now. Hmm, I suppose it is about time to release the lanterns.
Thankfully Granny Ruoxin always remembers such traditions. Let's go make a wish together, shall we?
I wonder if Mr. Adeptus will come to Lantern Rite...
At a festival like this one... the more, the merrier.
Think it's about time to release a Xiao Lantern now...
You're here. Well then, let us prepare. We shall begin releasing the Xiao Lanterns once night falls.
Ah, you must still have others you'd like to invite then? We can wait awhile longer.
It's such a busy Lantern Rite this year...
This is exactly how a festival should be!
Heh, thank you. Let's go release some Xiao Lanterns in a bit.
When will I get to release a Xiao Lantern...
I wonder what food I should try...
With so many of us gathered together now, things are finally starting to feel like a festival.
Heh, now let's release this Xiao Lantern together, shall we?
I wish everyone excellent health and good fortune in the coming year.
And may all the youngsters, wherever they are, see their dreams come true...
Alright Granny Ruoxin, if we wait any longer, the food I prepared will start getting cold.
Wow! Look at all the tasty food!
Can we go now, Granny?
Oh, children... Very well then, off you go now.

dialogue.sit: Won't you be joining them, Granny Ruoxin?

dialogue.t: Oh, me? I'm in no hurry. Besides, I'd like to watch the Xiao Lanterns awhile longer.
Which reminds me, these are for you, dear. It's my way of saying thank you for helping prepare all the festivities.
You're most welcome. From the looks of it, you must still be quite young. I imagine that all this running around must have left you quite tuckered out indeed...
Why don't you stay with us for a while and join the festivities?
It's good to have a rest after rushing about all year long...

quests.description: Something seems to be bothering Granny Ruoxin from Qingce Village…
